components.name: Text control
components.description: Unselected scene, theme or pause control; transparent with visible text.
components.css: .ds-preview { background: var(--poster-ground, #0b100e); } .ds-control { cursor: pointer; font: 15px/1.6 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--muted, #b4bbae); background: transparent; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid transparent; padding: 10px 0; min-height: 44px; } .ds-control:hover, .ds-control[aria-pressed="true"] { color: var(--ink, #f3ecdf); border-color: var(--accent, #d4b48b); } .ds-control:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #d4b48b); outline-offset: 6px; } .ds-control:disabled { opacity: .6; cursor: default; }

components.name: Selected text control
components.description: Pressed scene or pause control, using the same underline as hover.
components.css: .ds-preview { background: var(--poster-ground, #0b100e); } .ds-control { cursor: pointer; font: 15px/1.6 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--muted, #b4bbae); background: transparent; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid transparent; padding: 10px 0; min-height: 44px; } .ds-control:hover, .ds-control[aria-pressed="true"] { color: var(--ink, #f3ecdf); border-color: var(--accent, #d4b48b); } .ds-control:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #d4b48b); outline-offset: 6px; } .ds-control:disabled { opacity: .6; cursor: default; }

components.name: Project navigation
components.description: Project links with authored decorative arrows; the first link hides on phones.
components.html: In the wild Get the skill
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 32px; background: var(--poster-ground, #0b100e); color: var(--ink, #f3ecdf); font: 15px/1.6 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--accent, #d4b48b); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #d4b48b); outline-offset: 6px; } .ds-nav svg { margin-left: 5px; width: 12px; height: 12px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.3; } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-nav { gap: 17px; font-size: 12px; } .ds-nav a:first-child { display: none; } }

components.name: Wordmark
components.description: Self-hosted Bodoni home link with a Georgia fallback.
components.html: Particle Sculpture
components.css: .ds-preview { background: var(--poster-ground, #0b100e); } .ds-wordmark { color: var(--ink, #f3ecdf); font: 26px/1.6 Bodoni, Georgia, serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-wordmark:hover { color: var(--accent, #d4b48b); } .ds-wordmark:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #d4b48b); outline-offset: 6px; } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-wordmark { font-size: 21px; } }

components.name: Interaction hint
components.description: Status copy near the stage bottom; this isolated preview shows its typography.
components.html: Move to scatter. Leave to reform.
components.css: .ds-hint { margin: 0; background: var(--poster-ground, #0b100e); color: var(--muted, #b4bbae); font: 13px/1.6 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: center; pointer-events: none; }

narrative.overview: Scope: root Apple / Bird example only, not defaults for the particle-sculpture skill or style studio. Preserve the api.lmm.best particle identity: recognizable three-dimensional subjects built from fine points, with Bodoni headlines and a quiet surrounding interface. The sculpture supplies color, depth and movement; the page uses an open ground and restrained text controls.
keyCharacteristics: A live point field with brush displacement and spring recovery.
Green-black and warm-paper themes, with editorial serif emphasis.
Flat framing, generous empty space and visible control labels.
dos: **Do** keep the Canvas ground identical to the page ground in both themes.
**Do** preserve visible labels, keyboard focus, pause, reduced motion and native mobile gestures.
donts: **Don't** replace the live point field with an image or an unrelated visual effect.
**Don't** add cards or decorative data widgets to this showcase.
